rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR"
export PERL_EXT_CFLAGS="$CFLAGS" export PERL_EXT_CPPFLAGS="$CPPFLAGS" export PERL_EXT_LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS"
# The Perl of the prefix: configure takes the first one in the path # otherwise, which is the one of the tools folder also when building for # the target. Its compiler settings are then used for the extensions and # its path ends up in the scripts. AWK="awk" \ "./configure" \ PERL="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/perl" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --libdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ --libexecdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ --enable-perl-xs \ --disable-rpath
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
find "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" -type f -name dir | xargs rm -f
# The .la files refer to libperl, which nothing needs. sed -i "/dependency_libs/ s/'.*'/''/" \ `find "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" -name '*.la'`
